steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Mhmm... Let me see, are all the crew members here?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Roll call!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Camerawoman... Lynn!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Here...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sound engineers... Love and Daisy!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Hehe, here!

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Is it really necessary to take attendance like this...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahem, the director is speaking. Others should keep quiet.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: And lastly, our dummy clapper... ${PlayerName}!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe, good enthusiasm! Keep it up and maybe I'll promote you to be an official employee!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm? Why do you sound so out of energy? Don't you want to make a name for yourself and get the job?

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr purr...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe... I almost forgot about you. Our big star... Stella!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Uh... who?
The girl picks up the little creature, rocking it gently.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Stella comes from far, far away, and is the most amazing animal ever!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But it got separated from its family. We have to bring Stella back to its family!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: This touching story is the theme of our movie! I hereby announce—the making of the great Stella movie officially begins!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: All right!

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr! Purr!
Those at the scene give some scattered applause.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm? Why is the clapping sound so weak? Someone is slacking off!
I think the script needs some plot twists and climaxes.
Otherwise, with no clear beginning or end, the movie would be boring. The audience won't like it.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh? What plot twists? Tell me, dummy clapper!
For example, Stella looks like a harmless creature, but it is actually a dangerous space spy.
And maybe, um, some Timecops will arrest it!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Timecops? What kind of Timecops?
They're a bunch of ducks in space gear. They keep the balance of the multiverse and what not.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Those are the characters you came up with? You're really not cut out to be a screenwriter...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... Lemme think... Hey, dummy clapper, that's an interesting idea!
The girl jumps in front of you.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It'd be even better if some characters tried to catch Stella! That way, not only will our movie have villains, but also conflict! It'll be exciting for sure! The script can go like this...
As OwO goes on and on about how the Timecop ducks catch the little critter, you notice Stella staring at you and shaking its ears in contempt.
Meanwhile, on the other side of Dillywood.
A dazzling light illuminates a back alley in Dillywood, as if space and time are getting torn apart. Several portals appear out of thin air.
Strange ducks waddle out of the portal one after another, strapped with all sorts of gear and quacking to each other.

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack, quack quack! Quack quack quack!
(Assembling all Timecops! Roll call!)
The leading duck stands in front of the others, appearing to be the commander.

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack!
(Obbo!)

steps.speaker: Obbo
steps.content:
Quack!
(Here!)

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack!
(Shobbo!)

steps.speaker: Shobbo
steps.content:
Quack!
(Here!)

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack!
(Rabbo!)

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack?
(Rabbo!)

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack!!!
(Rabbo!!!)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack!
(Coming!)
The commander calls out the same name several times before a duck with a red scarf and funky hairstyle finally shows up.

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack, quack quack quack quack, quack quack.
(Quack quack. Champions always arrive fashionably late, right Commander?)

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack! Quack quack!
(Champion my duck! Get in the line!)
The commander gives the late duck's butt a hard kick.

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack!
(All right! Everyone from the tactical team is here! "Operation Stella Hunt" officially commences.)

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack, quack quack!
(Pledge your wings to safeguard the stability of space-time and the balance of the multiverse!)

steps.speaker: Ducks
steps.content:
Quack quack!
(We pledge our wings!)
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh? Are you scared?

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Don't worry. No matter who comes, OwO will protect you!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'll beat anyone who dares to be mean to you with this lion's head, like this... Hiya! Hiya!
For some reason, OwO glances in your direction.

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr, purr...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hey, don't go! Where are you going?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Should we... follow her?

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: It's fine. I haven't seen such an energetic kid for a long time. Let her have her fun.
In an alley in Dillywood, the little critter confronts a group of strange ducks.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huff, huff, so you're here... Huh, these ducks... are so weird!

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Purr, purr!

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack, quack quack...
(Human, be wary of this creature...)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack.
(Don't worry, Commander. She's just a little kid.)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack, quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack!
(Hey, we're here to take away this Starbeast! Don't get in the way, kid!)

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What are you quacking about? I can't understand you!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But you do look like the Timecops that dummy clapper was talking about... So you guys really exist?

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack? Quack quack quack quack!
(What's going on? This kid doesn't understand what we're saying!)

steps.speaker: Commander Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack quack?
(Who has the universal translation device?)
The ducks all point at the duck with the red scarf.

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack, quack quack...
(I left in a hurry today so I forgot to bring it, quack quack...)
The girl picks up the little critter and looks curiously at the ducks.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hey Stella, these ducks are so odd. But I've figured out what to do about the movie!
